name: Zipper
overview: Download original media and its Jellyfin-associated external subtitles together in a ZIP package.
description: Zipper adds a Jellyfin Web action for packaging movies, episodes, seasons, or series. By default it includes the original media and all external subtitle tracks associated with the selected Jellyfin media source; recognized tracks or languages can be selected when desired. It preserves source bytes and does not transcode media or generate subtitles. Tested with Jellyfin Server/Web 12.0.0 and File Transformation 3.0.1.0.
changelog: Align dropdown download action with Jellyfin menu presentation, remove duplicate detail button, and preserve toolbar launcher during menu interactions.
